tonkin-bamboo-canes.lead: Strong, straight Tonkin canes for plant support, crafts and construction — graded, dried and supplied wholesale by the container.
tonkin-bamboo-canes.name: Tonkin bamboo canes
tonkin-bamboo-canes.desc: Slender yet remarkably strong, Tonkin canes are prized for their straightness and durability. A versatile natural support for gardens, nurseries, fencing frames and craft work — grown and dried without chemical treatment.

spec.v: Plant support, crafts, fencing frames, construction

decor-moso-bamboo-poles.lead: Large-diameter Moso poles for pergolas, cladding and decorative builds — straight, robust and naturally finished.
decor-moso-bamboo-poles.name: Decor Moso bamboo poles
decor-moso-bamboo-poles.desc: Thick, characterful Moso poles bring a warm, architectural presence to outdoor and interior projects. Ideal for pergolas, wall cladding, room dividers and statement décor — dense, robust and naturally developed.

bamboo-fencing-edging.lead: Chemical-free privacy screening that blends into any garden — supplied as rolls, panels and edging, wholesale and factory-direct.
bamboo-fencing-edging.name: Natural bamboo privacy fence
bamboo-fencing-edging.desc: Robust, sustainable and naturally developed without pesticides, formaldehyde or toxic glues. A popular choice for privacy screening and decorative purposes — blending effortlessly with any surface and adding an element of elegant, cozy warmth.

bamboo-fence-panels.lead: Rigid, framed bamboo panels for fast, tidy privacy screening — ready to mount and built to last outdoors.
bamboo-fence-panels.name: Bamboo fence panels
bamboo-fence-panels.desc: Framed bamboo panels deliver instant privacy with a clean, finished edge. Robust and weather-ready, they install quickly along boundaries, balconies and terraces — naturally grown and chemical-free.

bamboo-household-articles.lead: Everyday bamboo homeware and lifestyle goods — natural, renewable and produced to order for wholesale and private label.
bamboo-household-articles.name: Bamboo household articles
bamboo-household-articles.desc: A versatile range of bamboo homeware and lifestyle goods, crafted from a fast-renewing natural material. Produced to specification for distributors and brands seeking sustainable, fairly-priced products.

bamboo-flower-sticks.lead: Lightweight bamboo flower and plant sticks for nurseries and growers — graded, bundled and supplied in bulk.
bamboo-flower-sticks.name: Bamboo flower sticks
bamboo-flower-sticks.desc: Slim, sturdy support sticks for flowers, seedlings and potted plants. A nursery essential — naturally grown, consistently graded and supplied in bulk for growers and garden retailers.

bamboo-plywood.lead: Strong, dimensionally stable bamboo plywood for furniture, interiors and construction — a renewable alternative to timber sheet.
bamboo-plywood.name: Bamboo plywood
bamboo-plywood.desc: Engineered bamboo sheet material combining strength, stability and a warm natural grain. A sustainable choice for furniture, cabinetry, flooring and interior fit-out — produced to specification.

reed-fencing.lead: Classic reed screening for gardens, balconies and terraces — natural, breathable privacy supplied by the roll.
reed-fencing.name: Reed fencing
reed-fencing.desc: Naturally harvested reed woven into breathable privacy screens with a soft, organic texture. A timeless choice for gardens, balconies and terraces — supplied as rolls in a range of heights.

other-natural-fencing.lead: Willow, brushwood and other natural screens for a rustic, characterful boundary — supplied wholesale by the roll.
other-natural-fencing.name: Other natural fencing
other-natural-fencing.desc: Beyond bamboo and reed, our range includes willow and brushwood screening for a warm, rustic look. Naturally harvested and woven into durable rolls — ideal for gardens and decorative boundaries.

natural-thatch-roof.lead: Natural thatch tiles and rolls for palapas, gazebos and tropical builds — durable, characterful roofing supplied to project.
natural-thatch-roof.name: Natural thatch roof
natural-thatch-roof.desc: Authentic natural thatch for palapas, gazebos, bars and resort builds. Supplied as tiles and rolls that layer into a warm, weather-shedding roof with unmistakable tropical character.

artificial-fence-rolls.lead: Low-maintenance artificial hedge and ivy fence rolls — instant year-round greenery for screening and décor.
artificial-fence-rolls.name: Artificial fence rolls
artificial-fence-rolls.desc: Realistic artificial ivy and hedge rolls deliver instant, evergreen privacy with no upkeep. UV-stable and weather-ready for balconies, walls and event screening where natural planting isn't practical.

artificial-green-wall-panels.lead: Interlocking artificial green wall and boxwood panels — lush, year-round vertical greenery for interiors and façades.
artificial-green-wall-panels.name: Artificial green wall panels
artificial-green-wall-panels.desc: Dense, interlocking green wall panels create a lush vertical garden effect indoors or out — with zero watering or trimming. UV-stable boxwood and mixed-foliage styles for feature walls, façades and retail.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: BestHome is a vertically integrated supplier of natural bamboo, reed and thatch products from Xiamen, China — committed to quality, sustainability and reliable wholesale and OEM supply.

hero.imageAlt: Decorative Moso bamboo in an outdoor setting
hero.title: A world where outdoor living meets natural simplicity.

story.title: Closer to nature, by design.
story.p1: BestHome was founded on a simple belief: that natural materials make better, warmer outdoor spaces — for homes, gardens and projects alike.
story.p2: From our production bases in Xiamen and Anhui, we grow, harvest and finish bamboo, reed and willow without chemical treatment, then ship them worldwide as fencing, poles, screening and thatch.
story.p3: Today we supply distributors, retailers and project buyers across Europe and beyond — combining factory-direct value with the consistency and service that keep partners coming back.
story.imageAlt: Natural bamboo fence in a garden
